what: When the title reaches 88% of the screen, letters pop up one by one (.032s) from 130% below, ±14° (alternating), .55 scale and transparent, over .72s back.out(2.4). Once set, letters within a radius around the cursor (1.9× the font size) rise .28em the closer they are, tilt up to 11° away from the cursor and scale to 1.14 (.45s power3.out), and when the cursor leaves they return starting from the center in .014s steps over .9s elastic.out(1, .45). Waits until html.is-loading is removed

options.pop: With off, only the poke with no bounce (for already-standing text like a wordmark)
options.poke: If off, only the bounce without the poke
options.rise: Bounce distance (% of letter height), default 130
options.[data-fx-part=char]: Pre-split children (picture letters, wordmark) — if present, the text isn’t split and these are animated instead
